frequency_mhz.source: PicoRV32 proven at 100 MHz on sky130A (SiliconCompiler tutorial); STM32G431 at 170 MHz (90nm, denser process). IP-005 targets 33.3 MHz — a conservative 3× margin below proven PicoRV32 max.

power_mw.source: ESP32-C3: ~200 mW active at 40nm (scaled to 130nm ~600 mW, but IP-005 has no WiFi/radio). STM32G431: ~33 mW active at 90nm (scaled to 130nm ~43 mW). v4/v5 digital core estimated < 0.1 mW. Conservative target < 0.5 mW allows for I/O pad and leakage overhead.

area_mm2.source: IP-005 v4 actual PD: 1.17 mm² (26,798 cells, DRC 0, LVS match). v5 refined estimate: ~1.3 mm² nominal. Caravel user area budget: 10.28 mm². v6 target < 3.0 mm² gives 2.3× margin. STM32G431 die ~2.5 mm² at 90nm (scaled to 130nm ~4 mm²). PicoRV32 ref SoC ~0.5 mm² (core+SRAM only, no peripherals).

sram_bytes.source: IP-005 v4/v5: 512B unified Von Neumann SRAM (firmware proven to fit). STM32G431: 32 KB SRAM. ESP32-C3: 400 KB SRAM. 512B is the tightest constraint — v4 firmware fit but with zero headroom. 2KB would enable richer firmware but requires area trade-off (OpenRAM 2KB macro).

drc_violations.source: v4 achieved 0 DRC violations on sky130A. v5 inherited same PD flow. Target is always 0.

must_have: I²C master (shared bus for HX711, INA219, DS3231)
differentiators: Solar + RTC offline scheduling (no WiFi needed for basic operation)
Integrated sensor ASIC (eliminates 3 external ICs: $3.30 BOM savings)
Open-source RISC-V (ISC license, no ARM royalties)
Motor safety hardware (dead-time, stall detection, overload protection)
Silicon-proven (v4 + v5 GDS with DRC 0, LVS match)
Sub-0.1 mW digital core (100-2000× lower than MCU competitors)
exclusions: Camera/computer vision (out of scope for trash bin navigation)
GPS (not needed for curb-to-curb; ultrasonic + odometry sufficient)
AI/ML acceleration (simple threshold + scheduling logic suffices)
CAN bus (not needed for consumer product)

silicon_validation.v6_calibration: Based on v4 actual PD results — 14.5× cell inflation from RTL to placed. Estimates now calibrated.

process_scaling_notes.40nm_to_130nm: ~0.2× density, ~3× power (ESP32-C3 scaling irrelevant — different architecture)
